source_findings.finding: Supervisor repeats runtime_guard then current_address every five seconds. Guard/command exception, changed configuration, or unexpected sshd child exit unwinds through finally and terminates listener.

Guard rejects unsafe/missing mounts, unexpected protected submounts, any escaped mount path anywhere in mountinfo, changed root/state device identity, unsafe metadata, wrong immutable package bindings, invalid identity/config/authorized keys, and blkid failures/timeouts. Plain content reads may change atime but guarded metadata comparisons do not include atime.

Address loss/change stops old listener; loss waits up to 60 seconds before error. Ambiguous global IPv4 or failed ip command also causes exception. Persistent refusal is compatible with repeated guard/startup failures or externally killed/stopped service, but does not distinguish these.

Restart=on-failure with 10-second delay. Unit has no explicit namespace isolation or KillMode override; systemd default control-group kill behavior can terminate active SSH descendants when the unit stops. RuntimeDirectory=sshd is maintained by systemd.

prepare uses manifest authentication, repeated live snapshots, readonly inactive-root block FD with O_EXCL/flock, full root hashing and readonly debugfs metadata extraction. It performs no mount/namespace change, selector publication, service signal, or network reconfiguration. Plan JSON prints only after make_plan completes, so blank output does not locate failure.
clock_context imports the local policy helper and checks timesync directory bindings without opening live clock state. No sd-bus/network reconfiguration is present in prepare path.

Production listener is sshd -D -e -f /run/a733-management/sshd_config. Separate sshd -T without -f does not target that listener or signal it; absence of default host keys explains that standalone validation failure, not listener termination.
